name: Fujiwara Namiko
source:
Jinyou appearing in Touko's route. Second-year student of Kamizawa Academy, and [spoiler]obsessed with Ichinotani Touko. Due to her mom having sex with many guys frequently for her own enjoyment, she grew to hate that sight, and thus ends up hating the opposite sex altogether[/spoiler].
Her ascendant is a [url=http://www.matthewmeyer.net/blog/2010/10/20/a-yokai-a-day-kage-onna]Kage-onna[/url] (the shadow of a woman often cast on the paper doors of a haunted house, but when one checks the other side, there is nobody there. She may be accompanied by noises as well), and for that reason she can creep into any nook and cranny by following their shadow.
